title: Traffic Slice Explorer and Rollout Health Playbook
creator: Aisha Malik
description: Build an interactive Traffic Slice Explorer in Console plus an accompanying Rollout Health Playbook. The explorer surfaces per-route, per-cohort metrics and traces for canary/A-B/shadow experiments with diff views, statistical signal flags, and a guided set of remediation steps (health playbook) to support on-call and PM/engineer runbooks. Scope: dashboard tiles, cohort diff visualizations, sample trace linking, auto-rollback integration hooks, and exportable snapshot for postmortems.
acceptance_criteria: Console has a Traffic Slice Explorer view that lists active rollouts and experiments with per-route metrics (p50/p95 latency, token cost, error rate, throughput) for each cohort
Users can select any two cohorts and view a time-aligned diff pane with delta metrics and simple statistical significance indicators
Each cohort row links to representative traces and the underlying request sample set (at most 1000 rows) for quick root-cause investigation

Health Playbook appears as contextual guidance in the explorer: automated suggested remediations (scale up, pause, rollback, adjust weights) and link-to-rollback action that triggers the auto-rollback policy when configured
Explorer can surface shadow traffic results without impacting production metrics and can flag regressions introduced by shadowed model variants
Telemetry and instrumentation tags are in place (rollout_id, cohort_id, route_id) and mapped to the Console’s trace view and cost breakdowns
End-to-end QA: create a canary rollout, generate traffic with synthetic prompt sets, observe diff UI, and verify auto-rollback triggers when configured conditions meet threshold
